newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zodiac denies buyout report, stock up.
newsitem.headline: Zodiac denies buyout report, stock up.

text.p: French aerospace equipment supplier Groupe Zodiac SA strongly denied on Friday a press report it was in buy-out talks with Lockheed Martin.

"I can only repeat that we deny there are any plans to change the ownership. It's ridiculous," a Zodiac spokesman said. He said an article in La Vie Francaise reporting Lockheed's interest in buying Zodiac was speculation.
Zodiac shares were up 3.42 percent at 1,450 francs per share at 0958 GMT.
The firm supplies equipment such as aircraft evacuation slides, passenger seats and life rafts.
Zodiac had 1995/96 sales of 3.4 billion francs. It has not published profit figures for the year but posted 1994/95 net profit before goodwill amortisation of 174 million francs, the spokesman said.
Since the French government moved earlier this year to consolidate its fragmented defence industry, rumours have circulated on a number of possible takeovers.
The aerospace sector accounts for some two-thirds of Zodiac's turnover. The firm is profitable, with a strong position in the industry and a worldwide presence, the spokesman said.
